title: sCrAmBlEd?HaCkZ!
summary: A 2006 promotional video for sCrAmBlEd?HaCkZ!, a music software project that analyzes and reassembles sampled audio and video in real time, tied to themes of sampling and copyright.
why: HN mentions it as an early example of corpus-based concatenative synthesis and audio-matching techniques.

quote.text: It splits music videos into small portions ahead of time and then later it reassembles them on the fly according to audio input.
